svg.title: E-Ticket platform UI/UX design board (v2)
svg.desc: Static vector preview of the nine screens defined in design/v2/build_figma.js. Illustrative sample data only.
svg.text: 9 screens · 1440×900 · mirrors design/v2/build_figma.js · sample data only — no payment or win implied
Your tickets, orders and wallet status in one clear place.
Choose tickets, review the server price, then follow payment status.
Continue checkout to see the method and latest status.
Ticket serials appear after confirmed delivery.
A ticket is not a win until the published result
Every package shows its included series, price and availability before checkout.
A compact introduction to current series.
A broader mix of available ticket series.
Availability is checked again when an order is reserved.
These cards use illustrative titles and prices; live catalog data comes from the server.
A visual ticket card with transparent result status — no scratch-to-reveal action.
Decorative ticket surface · not an instant reveal game
Winning status is shown only after the server
The public result page exposes a commitment, revealed seed and reproducible winner evidence.
A card gesture never changes the outcome.
Server-priced order. The method starts a process — it does not mark the order paid.
Configured bot must send an invoice
Only configured methods can create a real payment attempt.
Never pay from a demo screen
Payee details appear only in a
No payment is initiated by this Figma design.
See the amount cap, verified destination and locked-funds status before you request.
One unresolved request per user; exact matching in V1.
A submitted request first places a hold.
Waiting for buyer → Matched → Under review / Settled
Late or uncertain payments stay in review.
Browse series, review orders and follow the published
Design preview · no purchase or win implied
Use your email and password to access your dashboard.
No payment or ticket is created during sign-in or registration.
Browse series, review orders and follow the published
Design preview · no purchase or win implied
Use your name and email to create an account.
No payment or ticket is created during sign-in or registration.
Server-recorded counts support review; they are not payment verification.
A UTR, screenshot or receiver statement must not silently approve a payment. All decisions need audited evidence.
Every action is permissioned, audited and constrained by the backend state machine.
Admin role gates and redacted audit metadata.
Draft → publish → open → close; inventory and frozen snapshots.
Commit → close → draw → post prizes → publish; reproducible proof.
Manual evidence review; signed provider/Telegram events only.
50% cap, one unresolved request, exact match and safe holds.
Evidence-backed review; no automatic payout or silent reversal.
Integer-paise balanced allocation and read-only reports.
Coupons and pending rewards; no automatic reward credit.
